When choosing takes, lines or cut points from footage, follow [local footage review](../edit-video/SKILL.md#review-footage-locally) first.

Ask first, unless the request already answers it:

- Will they finish in CapCut desktop, web or the phone app?

Before driving CapCut with computer-use, ask; "do it in CapCut" alone doesn't answer that.

Know:

- Voyager has no CapCut project writer. Hand off files: clips, voice-over and music as
  separate files, and captions as a UTF-8 SRT, in one project folder with a short note of the
  clip order, trims and where each audio file sits. An assembled MP4 is a finished video, not
  an editable CapCut timeline; say so when you hand one over.
- SRT import works in CapCut desktop and web; the phone app can't import subtitle files.
  Import the SRT against the cut it was timed from, and check an early and a late cue after
  any trim.
- Cut and caption the piece with [edit-video](../edit-video/SKILL.md) and voice it with
  [voiceover](../voiceover/SKILL.md) first, so CapCut only adds the finishing touches.
